title: Would You Pay $25k for a Frictionless Family Vacation? - NewsBreak
text:
By Editor recommendations ,
10 hours ago When I became a parent, well-meaning friends warned me: "There's no such thing as vacation when you have small children; there's just parenting in a different location." On our first family trip, when my daughter was four months old, I understood what they meant. If vacations formerly involved spontaneity, relaxation, and sleeping in, traveling with a child required early nights and early mornings, rigid routines, an insane amount of luggage, and the constant vigilance inseparable from early parenthood. She's four now, and I love showing her the world, but our trips are rarely relaxing. When I received an invitation to Beaches Turks & Caicos, I was curious about whether a family-friendly, luxury all-inclusive could be the key to a more chilled, enjoyable vacation for everyone. Read full article
